title: Ansible on a Small Network
intro: **What earns a milestone.** Each lab milestone fires when the student's `dojo netlab check <lab>` passes (exit 0): the checker confirms the pod's end state from outside, on both branches, and that the manual and automated branches agree. Labs 5, 7 and S1-S3 are stretch and not `core`. The S labs are numbered 9-11 here because a catalog lab id must be `labN`.
